sn35.32:1.1: Sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyaṃ vo bhikkhave paṭipadaṃ desissāmi taṃ suṇātha || || Katamā ca sa bhikkhave sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyā paṭipadā || ||
sn35.32:2.1: Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave cakkhu niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.32:4.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti ||
sn35.32:6.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkham viparināmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.32:8.1: Rūpā || la || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ || || Cakkusamphasso nicco vā anicco vā ti || ||
sn35.32:10.1: pidam cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.32:12.1: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.32:14.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam anupassituṃ Etam mama eso hamasmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.32:18.1: Rasā || Jivhāviññāṇaṃ || || Jivhāsamphasso || la || Yam pidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.32:20.1: ||dhammā || pa || manoviññāṇaṃ || mano samphasso nicco vā anicco vā ti || ||
sn35.32:22.1: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi niccam aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.32:24.1: Yam panāniccam dukkham vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti ||

sn35.32:28.1: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati rūpesu pi nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇe pi nibbindati || || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā tasmim pi nibbindati || || pe || || Jivhāya pi nibbindati || rasesu pi || la || Yam pidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmim pi nibbindati manasmim pi nibbindati || dhammesu pi nibbindati || manoviññāṇe pi nibbindati manosamphasse pi nibbindati || || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tasmim pi nibbindati nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇiyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti ti || || Ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyā paṭipadā ti || || Sabbavaggo tatiyo || ||
sn35.32:29.0: Tassuddānam || || Sabbaṃ ca dve pi pahānā || || Parijānā apare duve || Ādittam andhabhūtaṃ ca || Sāruppā dve ca sappāyā || Vaggo tena pavuccati || ||
